title: The Marker
summary: Wren's debt to the Cult is a marker, cut in three, and three harvesters carry the pieces. Until it's broken the Cult can come and collect her. Dace Pike wants it broken: she owes him too.

steps.journal: Defeat three harvesters' leaders at the Canal Locks: every fifth wave, the one whose cage glows (an orange bar). They carry the marker's pieces.

ready: All three pieces of Wren's marker. Take them to Dace Pike at the Drowned Eel in Saltmere.
done: Dace fitted the marker's three pieces together on his counter and fed them to the stove. Wren is off the Cult's books.
